title: Pilot: action-complete H40 afterstate corpus and distributional ranker offline gate
hypothesis: On roots harvested from fair-D1 development games, a compact residual-CNN afterstate evaluator trained on successor-closed H40 scenario labels (every legal sibling, 8 aligned chance scenarios, phase-greedy D1 continuation) ranks held-out whole-origin siblings non-inferiorly to exact fair D4 on top-1 accuracy, pairwise accuracy, and normalized regret against the scenario-mean H40 outcome ranking.

data.reuseDisclosure: All gameplay seeds come from the named lease and become permanent public-development data once read. Roots are split into train/calibration/held-out folds by whole origin game before any label is inspected. No historical panel, protected, or final data is read. The frozen 477-root H200 panel is not used for model selection.

metrics.primary: Held-out whole-origin top-1 action accuracy of the model's scenario-averaged ranking against the scenario-mean H40 outcome ranking, compared with exact fair D4's top-1 accuracy on the same roots.
secondary: within-root pairwise accuracy and normalized regret versus the same target, model and fair D4
quantile calibration (80% interval coverage) on held-out afterstates
label stability: per-root Spearman correlation of action rankings between independent scenario halves
action completeness (fraction of legal siblings with labels; must be 1.0)
logical work and wall time per corpus root; training wall time and peak shared memory
metrics.uncertaintyMethod: Two deterministic held-out half-folds by origin-game hash; a metric counts only if it moves the same direction in both halves. No complete-game confidence intervals are produced at this tier.

passCriteria: Corpus is successor-closed: every non-trivial harvested root (>=2 legal actions) has labels for every legal sibling under all 8 scenarios.

Label stability floor: mean per-root Spearman correlation between scenario-half action rankings >= 0.5 on held-out roots; below this the outcome is inconclusive (labels too noisy), not a pass or a theory rejection.
Model top-1 accuracy >= fair D4 top-1 accuracy - 0.02 on each held-out half-fold.
Model pairwise accuracy >= fair D4 pairwise accuracy - 0.02 on each held-out half-fold.
Model normalized regret <= fair D4 normalized regret + 0.02 on each held-out half-fold.
80% quantile interval coverage on held-out afterstates within [0.70, 0.90].
All CHECK-tier mechanics, legality, determinism, reflection, information-boundary, and resource-bound tests pass before any label is inspected.
gate.failureAction: Record a valid negative (or inconclusive, if the stability floor fails) result for this exact configuration, keep the corpus manifest for diagnosis, and open no gameplay tier.
gate.passAction: Register a successor SCREEN experiment: 32 paired public-development games of the frozen 1-ply chance-averaged afterstate policy with exact fair-D4 fallback versus unchanged fair D4. The candidate, corpus, and thresholds are not retuned on the held-out fold first.

stopConditions: Stop on any rules, information-boundary, legality, determinism, or parity failure.
Stop corpus generation after 4 hours wall, 256 harvest games, or 16000 roots, whichever comes first.
Stop fair-D4 comparator labeling after 3 hours wall.
Stop training after 2 hours GPU wall or 30 epochs, whichever comes first.
Stop immediately on out-of-memory or on host available memory falling below 16 GiB.
Stop on any read of a seed outside the named lease.
expectedArtifacts: runs/<run-id>/corpus/*.ndjson corpus rows with content manifest
runs/<run-id>/model/*.pt frozen model bytes and training log
runs/<run-id>/gate/gate-report.json with all primary and secondary metrics
